title: WRITE record FROM WORKING-STORAGE — copy source-into-record then write; FROM is implicit MOVE
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. WRITE-LINE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  REPORT-FILE.
       01  REPORT-REC PIC X(132).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-OUTPUT-LINE PIC X(132).
      *> WRITE REPORT-REC FROM WS-OUTPUT-LINE is short-hand for:
      *>   MOVE WS-OUTPUT-LINE TO REPORT-REC
      *>   WRITE REPORT-REC
      *> The MOVE happens before the WRITE. Mutating WS-OUTPUT-LINE
      *> after the WRITE does not affect the written record.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           WRITE REPORT-REC FROM WS-OUTPUT-LINE.
notes: WRITE...FROM is a common idiom for line-printer / report-file output. A Java rewrite using PrintWriter.println(line) is the natural target; the spec must surface FROM as 'copy then write' so the rewrite doesn't accidentally hold a reference.
